# pvgis_tmy.csv

Typical Meteorological Year direct normal irradiance (column `Gb(n)`), from the EU JRC PVGIS service (https://re.jrc.ec.europa.eu/pvg_tools/en/), fetched by `python -m beamdown fetch-dni --source pvgis` for this project's site (lat -10.0, lon -52.0).
